_comment: Per-group birthday list. Copy to birthdays.json (gitignored runtime data; usually managed from chat via date.add / date.del in each group). Top-level keys are group ids. A matching birthday is appended as a wish line under that group's daily dateimg push, so the group must have dateimg enabled.

_field_help.who: the full line to send on the birthday
_field_help.lunar: false = fires on Gregorian mm/dd; true = fires when today's LUNAR date == mm/dd (auto-updates every year)
